```{=html}
<h1 class="gcpp-hero__h1">NAS&#8209;Technology Track</h1>
```

::: {.gcpp-hero__lede}
NAST seeks to build high-quality scholarship at the intersection of technology and geopolitics, an area increasingly central to questions of national power, economic strategy, and foreign policy, yet under-studied in Indian academia and policy research.
:::
:::
:::
:::

```{=html}
<!-- ============ RESEARCH DOMAINS ============ -->
<div class="gcpp-section">
  <div class="gcpp-container">
    <span class="eyebrow">Research domains</span>
    <h2 class="gcpp-h2">Propose your own topic</h2>
    <p class="nasx-prose" style="margin-bottom:24px;">This is a general call for research proposals. Fellows are not required to work on pre-assigned themes. You propose a topic within the broad domain of technology and geopolitics. The domains encompass, but are not limited to, the following areas.</p>
    <ul class="unit-list">
      <li><span class="u">T.01</span> Artificial Intelligence and National Security</li>
      <li><span class="u">T.02</span> Semiconductors and Supply Chain Resilience</li>
      <li><span class="u">T.03</span> Cybersecurity and Digital Infrastructure</li>
      <li><span class="u">T.04</span> Space Technologies and Geopolitics</li>
      <li><span class="u">T.05</span> Lethal Autonomous Weapons and Drones</li>
      <li><span class="u">T.06</span> Biotechnology and Biosecurity</li>
      <li><span class="u">T.07</span> Quantum Technologies</li>
      <li><span class="u">T.08</span> Nuclear Technologies</li>
      <li><span class="u">T.09</span> Geospatial Technologies</li>
      <li><span class="u">T.10</span> Technology, Geoeconomics, and National Power</li>
    </ul>
    <p class="nasx-prose" style="margin-top:24px;">As part of the fellowship, fellows can choose to enrol in any of the ECCs running in that period, and will have access to special GCPP sessions by guest lecturers on Technology Geopolitics.</p>
  </div>
</div>
```

<!-- ============ APPLICATION PROCESS ============ -->
<div class="gcpp-section">
  <div class="gcpp-container">
    <span class="eyebrow">Application process</span>
    <h2 class="gcpp-h2">How to apply</h2>
    <div class="apply-list no-codes">
      <div class="apply-item">
        <div class="body">
          <h3>Proposal & Statement of Purpose</h3>
          <p>Submit a research proposal of 1,000–1,500 words outlining the topic, the research questions, and the approach. Proposals should clearly identify the gap in existing scholarship and explain why the topic merits sustained attention. Also submit a 500–800-word Statement of Purpose explaining your reasons for pursuing a fellowship in this domain. Only one author per proposal will be accepted.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="apply-item">
        <div class="body">
          <h3>Interviews</h3>
          <p>Submitted proposals undergo internal review, and applicants whose proposals are shortlisted will be invited to a virtual interview.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="apply-item">
        <div class="body">
          <h3>Fellow announcements</h3>
          <p>Up to 6 selected candidates will be invited to join the 2026–2027 NAS fellowship cohort.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
